description: Serves a Markdrop Guides help center or docs site on the customer's own subdomain (for example help.example.com). Adds one CNAME record at the host the customer chose, pointing at cname.guides.markdrop.in; Markdrop issues the HTTPS certificate itself.
variableDescription: No variables. Apply with a host (the subdomain); the template refuses the bare domain, since a CNAME can't sit at the zone apex.
